The '''Bishop''' (formerly '''Episcop''') is the [[village]] priest and as the keeper of the local [[graveyard]] you'll be seeing him quite often. As a visitor [[NPCs|NPC]] he is only available to talk to on {{Day|Pride}} when he has arrived at the [[church]].
== Quests ==
===Fix the Graveyard===
Upon arriving at the graveyard for the first time he will acknowledge you as the new graveyard keeper. He asks you to improve the [[graveyard]] to 5 {{Graveyard Rating}}, and after doing so he will give you the [[Perks|Preacher Perk]] allowing you to hold [[sermons]] in the local [[church]] and gaining access to the [[Alchemy Lab|alchemy lab]] and the [[study table]] in the cellars. You'll earn 10 {{happiness}} from this.

Note that when you open the church, it counts as your prayer for the day. You will not be able to choose a prayer to get faith or donations for the service. After the ceremony, the Bishop disappears from his usual post next to the church for the remainder of the day.

===Bowls for the Soup Kitchen===
Bishop needs {{Item|Ceramic bowls|20}} to serve soup at his Soup Kitchen near the [[Church]]. He gives you access to [[Building (Tech Tree)#Clay|"The Concept of Dirt" technology]] which lets you gather [[sand]] and [[clay]]. To make his bowls you'll need to get [[clay]] from digging at any of the craggy holes around the [[Locations|map]] (one is directly south of the [[The Graveyard|graveyard]]), and then use it with [[Alchemy|water]] at the [[Potters wheel|potter's wheel]]. You'll earn 10 {{happiness}} from bringing the bowls and the "Cleric's Beginner's Guide" worth {{Techpoint|blue|+5}}.

===Improve the Graveyard===
To expand the church he requests you to get the [[graveyard]] to 30 {{Graveyard Rating}}. You receive 5 {{Happiness}} for completing the quest.

===Improve the Church===
Furthermore, he requests you to get the [[church]] to 20 {{Church Rating}}. By using [[candle]]s in the [[candelabra I]] or [[candelabra II]], you can increase the score temporarily and finish the task without having to build an expensive interior. You receive 5 {{Happiness}} for completing the quest.

===Bring Quality Fish Fillets===
The Bishop would like some freshly caught {{Item|Quality fish fillet|4|Copper}} (Must be {{Quality|Copper}}) because he can't eat meat. [[Bream]] is catchable with a 100% rate at the river far north of the church (you need to unblock the path) without bait. You can also catch it at the waterfall [[fishing]] spot which is across the stone bridge west of the [[graveyard]] and directly north using {{Item|Maggot}} as bait. You can also purchase them from the lighthouse. The fillet itself is prepared in your kitchen. You receive 10 {{Happiness}} for completing the quest.

===Bring a Building Permission===
After delivering {{Item|Quality fish fillet|4|Copper}}  the bishop will complain about bureaucracy. You have to bring him a {{item|Building permission}} (it costs {{money|2000}}) to transform the [[church]] into a big church. Bear in mind though, after the upgrade, you won't be able to do any church services until you become a rightful citizen, that's another {{money|300}}.

===Improve the Church further===
He wants you now to improve the church once more, this time to 50 {{Church Rating}} though!

===Improve the Graveyard further===
As before, but now he wants you to increase your graveyard to 200 {{Graveyard Rating}}.

===Gold Quality Marble Statues===
After your [[graveyard]] reaches 100 {{Graveyard Rating}}, he admires your graveyard and suddenly realizes he needs {{item|A carved piece of marble|3|gold}} of himself! Three of {{quality|gold}} quality, to be exact. Hand those over for 10 {{happiness}}. You should now have 70 {{happiness}} and could ask to upgrade your [[church]] to a cathedral.

Please note, your chances to get{{item|A carved piece of marble||gold}} of {{quality|gold}} quality increases to 80% percent once you have unlocked the tricks of the trade perk from the tech tree.

<s>'''WARNING:''' You will need {{item|aristocrat papers}} and an {{item|accepted invitation}} to perform any church services in the cathedral. (The [[Inquisitor]] works for this.)</s><small><sup>(No longer required to preach - potential temporary Bug?)</sup></small>

===Bring Aristocrat Papers===
After upgrading to the cathedral, speak to the bishop and he will tell you he needs {{item|aristocrat papers}}.

You can become an aristocrat via the [[royal services]] in front of the [[church]] for {{money|120000}}. You then get the papers for free. Show them to the bishop for another 10 {{happiness}}. <s>You will need them to hold services in the cathedral.</s><small><sup>(No longer required - potential Bug?)</sup></small>

[[File:Lost Aristocrat papers.png|thumb]]

===Bring an Accepted Invitation===
After upgrading to the cathedral, the Bishop also demands an {{item|Accepted invitation}} from you.

Speak to the [[Inquisitor]] about the papers, but he will turn you down. You will need to get the invitation from the [[merchant]] instead. This can only be done once you have reached 90 {{Happiness}} with the [[merchant]]. Turn in the invitation for another 10 {{happiness}}.

===Hold the Ceremony===
Once you have turned in both required papers, you should have acquired 90 {{happiness}} with the Bishop and will be able to hold the ceremony.  

Speak with the Bishop again to finish his quest line. You see a cutscene, where the two brothers reunite and earn the achievement "Two Brothers". You will receive the {{item|Mirror of pride}} from the Bishop and the {{item|Salty fork}} from the [[merchant]]. 

Note that when you hold the ceremony, it counts as your prayer for the day (at least if you hold the ceremony before doing a prayer). You will not be able to choose a prayer to get faith or donations for the service. After the ceremony, the Bishop disappears from his usual post next to the church for the remainder of the day.

===Purchasing===
*Will not buy back their inventory, except at Tier III.
*Will not buy related oddities, such as paper products, [[beeswax]], or [[hemp rope]].
*Selling most sermons is ill-advised, as the requisite materials can be sold for more elsewhere. <i>(see [[Astrologer#Trading|Astrologer]])</i>

== Trivia ==
* The statue which will be placed in the graveyard from fulfilling "Gold Quality Marble Statues" resembles "Buddy Christ" from the movie "Dogma".
* His former name, Episcop, is derived from Greek and literally means "supervisor" or "protector". The word was then adopted into Latin and is nowadays used in several Slavic languages.
